meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development (TDD) process used when writing code. Use whenever you are adding any new code, unless the user explicitly asks to skip TDD or the code is exploratory/spike.

copy.tagline: 用测试驱动的方式编写新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想在添加代码时始终遵循测试驱动开发
copy.tagline_en: Write new code using test-driven development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to follow test-driven development when adding code

howto.what: 装好此技能后，当你要求编写新代码时，Claude 会采用测试驱动开发（TDD）流程：先写测试，再写代码，逐步增加测试，确保所有测试通过，并重构代码。它会遵循严格的步骤：计划测试、实现最小代码通过测试、运行所有测试、改进设计。
howto.when: 当你要求编写任何新代码时触发（除非你明确要求跳过 TDD 或代码是探索性的）。默认进入 TDD 流程。

say.text: 用 TDD 写一个加法函数，自动模式
say.note: Claude 会全自动执行 TDD 步骤，无需确认。

say.text: 用 TDD 写一个计算器，人工模式
say.note: Claude 会在关键步骤等待你确认。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, when you ask to write new code, Claude will follow Test-Driven Development (TDD): write a test first, then code, incrementally add tests, ensure all pass, and refactor. It plans tests, implements minimal code to pass, runs all tests, and improves design.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever you ask to write any new code, unless you explicitly ask to skip TDD or the code is exploratory/spike. Default TDD flow.

say_en.text: Write an add function using TDD, auto mode
say_en.note: Claude will execute all TDD steps automatically without confirmation.

say_en.text: Write a calculator using TDD, human mode
say_en.note: Claude will wait for your confirmation at key steps.
